From: Marta Ivanova <marta.visa@consulateuk.gov.uk>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Elena Garcia <elena.garcia@globex.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 14:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: formal invitation for exec visas

Dear Ms. Bennett and Ms. Garcia,

Thank you for your correspondence. For visa processing we require the following from the host organization when applicants are attending short business workshops:
- A signed letter on company letterhead confirming purpose, full visitor names as on passport, intended travel dates, and a local contact with telephone number.
- A copy of the event programme/itinerary (one page acceptable).
- Confirmation of accommodation or responsibility for local costs if the host will cover them.

Please note: the consulate also accepts scanned PDFs of the signed letter (clearly legible) for appointment booking; originals are not required unless specifically requested. If you plan to include a statement of financial responsibility, include the name and title of the signatory authorizing that commitment.

Kind regards,
Marta Ivanova
Visa Officer — UK High Commission
